snippet.title: Ash & Adam's Existential Treads - Play the Demo!
snippet.description:
Part city builder, part retro vehicle shooter. Tear down the ruins of the old world and use what you find to build a settlement. Rescue survivors from the wastes. Defend your people against waves of attacks from the rogue AI that ruined the old world.  Try it for yourself now; download the demo from Steam or Itch.io.  We can't wait for you to play.  

Thanks a million if you wishlist on Steam... it really helps us out!

Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3580340/Ash__Adams_Existential_Treads/

Itch.io: https://ashadamsgames.itch.io/existential-treads

Bluesky: https://bsky.app/profile/ashandadamsgames.bsky.social
